candidates.name: Portal: request official copies
verified_facts: The portal workflow allows authorised users to request official copies of registers, title plans and documents.
The service concerns retrieval of registered documentary evidence.
semantic_limits: A successful portal request or official-copy delivery does not certify physical survey accuracy or terrain elevation.

candidates.name: Practice Guide 77: altering the register by removing land from a title plan
verified_facts: The guide describes the legal and evidential process for applications that seek alteration of registered title-plan extent.
Registration alteration depends on the application and supporting evidence rather than an automatic physical resurvey.
semantic_limits: Register alteration is a legal-record process and cannot be treated as a new terrain survey or vertical-accuracy upgrade.
